items.title: Google Project Zero Details ASLR Bypass on Apple Devices Using NSDictionary Serialization
items.description: A Google Project Zero researcher has detailed a novel technique for remotely leaking memory addresses on Apple’s macOS and iOS. This method can bypass a key security feature, Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR), without relying on traditional memory corruption vulnerabilities or timing-based side-channel attacks. The research originated from a 2024 discussion within the Project Zero […]…
